transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name is Kyle. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've been on hold for forty minutes before this, and my internet still isn't working after the engineer came yesterday. I'm so angry right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Yolanda. So the engineer visited yesterday, but your internet still isn't working. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, and I've been waiting forever on the phone, and nobody can tell me anything, and-

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you just shut up for a second and let me check.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What lights are on the router?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did the engineer connect the router to the new socket he fitted?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: He fitted a new socket in the hall, yes. The router is still plugged into the old one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's it. Plug it into the new socket in the hall.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Then it's fixed. Thank you for choosing S-Net.
